usedFor: OneHash Chat holds the conversations, and Google Docs receives a written record through “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “Conversation Status is Changed” in OneHash Chat, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: A status change marks a conversation moving on, so the Doc tab gets that update.

watchOut: “Conversation is Updated” and “New Message is Created” fire often, so the tab can change many times per conversation.
